{{Top|leg}}
The '''''Pulsator''''' was a device that when attached to a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], provided a low-level electrosynaptic pulse.

After learning a great deal about [[Assembler]] physiology, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] found that Assembler tissue could be regenerated using a pulsator, and returned [[Kud'ar Mub'at]] and his floating web to life around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Using the [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']] as a source of energy and parallel dataflow, Fett inserted the end of the pulsator tool (a metal needle) into a knot of ganglia inside the Assembler's skull and reanimated his dead corpse.
